scope: Static APK catalog snapshot comparison; no live API verification.
limitations: Version and distribution-channel effects are not isolated; do not attribute differences solely to channel.
Declared parameter unions are observations, not requiredness/default/authentication or compatibility guarantees.
Missing wire layouts are recorded as unavailable rather than interpreted as removed fields.
DEX indices, source offsets and declaration order do not count as API/schema changes.

http.comparison_scope: Union of explicitly named Query/Field/Path/Header/Part annotations per normalized verb+route; map/body-only parameters and runtime defaults are not inferred.

grpc.comparison_scope: Static service/method IDs and request/response marshaller type candidates; no proof of active backend or wire compatibility.

protobuf.comparison_scope: RawMessageInfo layout field numbers, type IDs, flags and presence/oneof indices. Java storage fields/constants are separate metadata and do not establish protobuf source names.
